title: Introduce prompt-set quality anchors and autodraft changelog bridge
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: Onboarding engineers often attach a few ad-hoc prompts to model profiles but we lack a structured, intent-tagged surface to drive automated quality summaries and changelog drafts. This PR introduces an opt-in PromptSet artifact and a derived Quality Anchor layer that ties model profile metrics to representative prompt intents. The system enables: 1) standardized prompt-set attachments at model-onboard time, 2) nightly anchor scoring (regression/improvement signals per intent), 3) an autodraft changelog bridge that synthesizes human-readable bullet points for release notes and rollback hints. What changed: new DB tables (prompt_sets, prompt_set_examples, quality_anchors), onboarding CLI flag (modelctl onboard --attach-promptset <id>), registry API endpoints to CRUD prompt sets, an evaluation worker that scores prompt sets against model variants, and a changelog generator plugin that consumes anchor diffs to produce autodraft text for release candidates. Rollout: default is opt-in via a feature flag 'promptset_quality_anchors' for the first 3 months. Migration: a background migration imports ad-hoc prompt snippets from legacy 'profile_notes' into new prompt_set_examples and tags them heuristically with intent buckets (completion, instruction-following, summarization, question-answer). Observability: added metrics (promptset.count, anchor.score.histogram, anchor.delta.alerts), tracing hooks for the scoring worker and a sample dashboard JSON bundled in docs. Backwards compatibility: no change to existing APIs unless feature flag enabled. Related work: ENG-2173 (intent taxonomy), ENG-2401 (autodraft release path). Checklist: - [x] DB schema + migration - [x] API + CLI surface - [x] Scoring worker + unit tests - [x] Changelog generator integration - [x] Feature flag gating - [x] Telemetry and dashboard stub - [x] Migration job and smoke import Tests: unit tests for intent tagging heuristics, end-to-end scoring simulation with small synthetic prompt sets, and integration test for autodraft generation. Security/Privacy: prompt examples are stored with owner ACLs; PII-scrubbing hook added to ingestion so adhoc snippets are redacted before persistence. Impact: expected to increase nightly job runtime by ~12% (measured in staging). Rollback path: disable feature flag + revert migration job (idempotent).

review_comments: Maya Chen: Nice design. Question: how do we guarantee prompt sets are representative and not noisy during scoring? Suggest adding a minimum example count and an entropy filter.
Author (Priya): Added minimum_examples=5 validation and a shannon-entropy-based filter in scoring worker; documented tradeoffs in onboarding doc.
Lars Müller: Please ensure the migration buffer doesn't create duplication if re-run. Also we need to rate-limit the nightly scoring to avoid AWS burst limits.
Author (Priya): Migration is idempotent keyed on content hash; scoring now runs through a token-bucket limiter and honors concurrency env var.
Diego Ramos: Approve after tests. Can we add a sample autodraft output to the changelog UI?
Author (Priya): Added sample JSON output and wiring to the changelog staging UI; screenshot attached in docs PR.
CI: All checks passed on re-run (lint, unit, integration, e2e).
release_notes: Added prompt-set artifacts and quality anchors to the model registry. Teams can attach intent-tagged prompt sets to model profiles to enable nightly quality anchors and autogenerated changelog drafts. Opt-in via feature flag 'promptset_quality_anchors'. See docs/onboarding/promptsets.md for migration and usage.
additional_notes: Follow-up tasks tracked in ENG-2289: add curator UI for editing prompt sets and ENG-2310: incorporate human review feedback into anchor scoring. Recommend enabling feature flag for a small pilot (3 internal models) for two weeks before broad rollout.
